chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which he draws attention to his excellence regarding the acceptance of his speech, command, and prohibition.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Imam Ali's authority in accepting his words and commands according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This introductory note establishes the theological basis for Imam Ali’s (AS) authority in Nahj al-Balagha, framing his sermons not merely as rhetorical exercises but as divinely sanctioned guidance rooted in his unique proximity to the Prophet Muhammad. By emphasizing the acceptability of his commands and prohibitions, it underscores the Shia concept of his infallible interpretation of the Quran and Sunnah, a status derived from his lineage and spiritual rank.
